shared_elements: low-relief carved signs/symbols on a stone surface
winged/curved emblem at the top of the field
paired symmetrical motifs flanking a central axis
rows of small repeated symbolic signs
rounded-top (arched) upper contour of the field
justification: Both surfaces bear shallow-relief symbolic devices organised around a vertical axis with a curved emblem near the top and circular/disc forms below, and both fields have a rounded upper edge. But A is a flat stela dominated by dense horizontal registers of small script signs beneath a row of standing figures, whereas B is a three-dimensional sculpted torso whose sparse, large, blobby emblems are distributed over a body's chest and shoulders with no writing or figural row; the conventions of rendering are quite unalike.
